pull.title: net_processing: always disconnect for SENDTXRCNCL after VERACK
pull.body:
As mandated by BIP 330:
> If "sendtxrcncl" was sent after "verack", the sender should be disconnected.

So, always disconnect such a peer, regardless of the value of `-txreconciliation`. Previously the code would ignore and not disconnect such a peer if `-txreconciliation=0`.

net_processing: always disconnect for SENDTXRCNCL after VERACK

As mandated by BIP 330:
> If "sendtxrcncl" was sent after "verack", the sender should be disconnected.

So, always disconnect such a peer, regardless of the value of
`-txreconciliation`. Previously the code would ignore and not disconnect
such a peer if `-txreconciliation=0`.
